run_generate_executables: run the script to generate shell wrapper executables for spot_rl modules in the conda bin directory
run_create_shell_wrappers: run the script to create bash wrapper scripts that source spot_rl launch shell scripts
run_create_python_wrappers: run the script to create bash wrappers that invoke spot_rl Python modules via sys.executable
review_orig_to_alias_mapping: review the orig_to_alias dictionary that maps spot_rl module paths to their executable alias names
run_set_executable_permissions: run the script to set chmod 0o775 permissions on each generated executable wrapper
